title: CareerLens Agent File Broker v1
scope: Workspace-scoped UTF-8 text files for the self-developed agent plane
path_rules: Paths must be non-empty, relative, POSIX-style and may not contain '..', '.', backslashes, colons, NUL or a leading //
The resolved path must stay under the configured root
Symlinks, junctions and non-regular files are denied at every checked component
Extensions outside the allowlist and files over the byte budget are denied
write_rules: Write calls require a matching approved invocation and canonical args_digest
The durable ledger key is (run_id, invocation_id)
A replay with the same digest returns the stored result and never overwrites the file
Writes use a temporary file plus atomic replace inside the workspace root
boundaries: This is a narrowly scoped file broker, not a complete OS sandbox.
Network, shell, executable files and arbitrary absolute paths remain unavailable to the agent.
